routerDesc: Picks which agent and which model should answer a request.
researcherDesc: Answers questions from the workspace, read-only, with citations.
author: Author
authorDesc: Creates pages and opens merge requests on existing ones.
reviewerDesc: Reviews a draft and reports issues with severities.
drafterDesc: Writes or rewrites one page of markdown from an instruction.
plannerDesc: Breaks a page into the list of pages that should follow it.
extractorDesc: Infers graph relations from a page. Emits stable keys, never translated.
glossaristDesc: Proposes glossary terms grounded in occurrences on the page.
transcriberDesc: Transcribes a scanned page image to markdown. Never summarises.
curatorDesc: Scans the workspace for stale, orphaned and duplicated pages.
architectDesc: Turns a description of a chain into a workflow definition to review.
cartographerDesc: Proposes the relations a page should declare, grounded in what it says.
archaeologistDesc: Reads a connected repository and drafts pages for the business logic no document declares.

route.wrongSurface: does not run on the {surface} surface
route.noCandidate: No agent passed the capability gate.
route.onlyCandidate: The only agent able to run this.

curation.noPages: This workspace has no pages yet.
curation.orphanDetail: This page declares no relations and nothing references it, so it will not surface through the graph — only through search. Adding a relation in its frontmatter puts it back on the map.

cartography.noPages: This workspace has no pages yet.
cartography.unconfirmedTitle: "{title}" has {count} inferred connection(s) nobody has confirmed
cartography.unconfirmedDetail: A model read these connections out of the text, but the page does not declare them. An inferred edge is the lowest-trust class there is and is replaced on every re-index; declaring it in the page's frontmatter makes it a fact the page itself asserts. Proposed: {list}.
cartography.graphUnavailable: The relation graph could not be read, so only the model's suggestions are included.
cartography.summary: Looked at {pages} pages and proposes relations for {found} of them.

review.cannotRun: The model routed at the reviewer cannot run it.
review.noPages: No indexed pages to review yet.
review.none: No page could be reviewed in this pass.

glossary.disabled: The AI assistant is disabled for this workspace.
glossary.budgetSpent: Stopped after {pages}: the workspace AI budget is spent.
glossary.nothingNew: Scanned {pages}; every term they use is already defined.

archaeology.noModel: No model is configured for the archaeologist, so the repository was inventoried and nothing was read.
archaeology.digestSkipped: The declared-knowledge digest could not be written, so the raw document headings were used instead.
archaeology.noCandidates: Read {docs} documents and {pages} pages for "{repository}"; every source file that decides something is already covered.
archaeology.budgetSpent: Stopped after {files} of {candidates} files: the workspace AI budget is spent.
archaeology.summary: Read {docs} documents and {pages} pages for "{repository}", then {files} source files nothing declares; proposes {findings} new pages.

warning.graphUnreadableOrphans: The relation graph could not be read, so the orphan check was skipped.
warning.graphUnreadableModelOnly: The relation graph could not be read, so only the model half ran.
warning.modelPassFailedStructuralOnly: The model pass failed, so only structural findings are included.
